JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.G.S. KAMAL  ORAL JUDGMENT 1.

After arguing the matter for some time, learned counsel for the appellant seeks leave to withdraw the appeal with a direction to the Trial Court to consider his application seeking for regular bail,
expeditiously.
In the event of the appellant submitting the application seeking regular bail, the same shall be considered by the Trial Court, as expeditiously as possible.
